ops_per_sample: 6-line FDN (HX_REVERB_LINES=6) + 8 scatter taps + 6 modulated allpasses; control (random walks, per-line delay targets, slews) every 24 samples, per-sample interpolated delays.
notes: v2 SCATTER->diffusion->FDN. Host bench 26.3 ns/sample default (=12.6 % device at x0.48), worst-case params avg 24.3, p99.9 block 31.3 (15 %). Defaults: RT60 ~9.3 s, DAMP 5.2k, SCATTER .65, SPREAD .8, DRIFT .12 Hz, SEED 7, BLOOM .5, CHAOS .5. Params 0..9 unchanged (MIX,DECAY,SIZE,WARP,DAMP,MODDEPTH,MODRATE,LOWCUT,WIDTH,PREDELAY); 10..15 new. Public wake() zeroes all state + buffers.
